description: 50-item labelled corpus for roadmap 1.5 business-rule extraction (ownRulesFor / splitRuleClauses). Includes single modal rules, quantifiers, temporal windows, passive invariants, prohibitions, compound multi-clause sentences and non-rule framing/marketing/stack sentences.

items.text: A clinic must never see another clinic's patients.
Refunds over $500 require two-person approval before disbursement.
Every ledger entry is immutable and append-only.
Settlement runs shall complete within 15 minutes of market close.
A seller can receive at most one payout per calendar day.
Sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Raw card numbers may never touch application logs or storage.
Inbound webhook deliveries are deduplicated by provider event id.
Self-approval of manual journal adjustments is prohibited.
Children under 13 cannot submit personal data without parental consent.
Password reset tokens are single-use and expire within 10 minutes.
Schema migrations must always be forward-only.
When an upload exceeds 10 MB, the gateway rejects the payload immediately.
Audit records older than 7 years are archived to cold storage.
Only verified practice managers can export billing summaries.
Every tool invocation is recorded in an append-only action log.
Closed accounting periods reject backdated inserts and edits.
A batch job must remain idempotent when replayed on the same date window.
Break-glass access has to state a reason and expire within 4 hours.
Failed login attempts lock the account after 5 attempts.
Personal contact fields are redacted before any log line leaves the host.
A booking may only be cancelled no later than 24 hours before start.
Each invoice keeps at least two decimal places in integer minor units.
External links in user comments are forbidden on child accounts.
If the audit sink is unreachable, the service refuses the state transition.
Kill switch activation halts active agent loops within one step.
Teachers may not read student records outside their assigned roster.
No tenant can consume more than 100 requests per minute.
Payouts over $1000 must receive dual approval, and audit logs can never be deleted.
Cancelled orders must release reserved inventory immediately; shipped orders cannot be edited.
All patient notes must be encrypted at rest, while clinicians may only access their own clinic.
Draft invoices are editable by billing clerks; posted invoices are immutable.
Every deletion request purges personal fields within 30 days, and a receipt is recorded without PII.
Backup archives are verified by SHA-256 checksum before restore.
Unregistered third-party ICT providers are blocked at startup.
A web app for small veterinary clinics that replaces messy spreadsheets.
Built with TypeScript, Hono and PostgreSQL on a single server.
Target users are freelance designers and small creative studios.
Today teams track upcoming renewals in a shared email inbox.
Designed to be fast, simple and clean on mobile phones.
A CLI tool for sorting holiday photos into dated folders.
Keeps everyone on the same page during Friday retrospectives.
Written in Rust for minimal memory usage on developer laptops.
A marketplace where local cyclists buy and sell used road bikes.
Used by internal operations staff across three regional warehouses.
Users can browse a catalogue of community gardening workshops.
It should feel calm and approachable for non-technical parents.
A library for parsing recurring calendar schedules in Go.
Deployed on a single Linux VM in Frankfurt with daily snapshots.
Teams currently paste status updates into three different chat channels.
